description: Source code for system management commands in Mattermost's CLI, including commands for server status, version, busy state, and support packet generation.

methods.name: getBusyCmdF
methods.description: Fetches and displays the server's busy state.

methods.name: setBusyCmdF
methods.description: Sets the server's busy state for a specified duration.

methods.name: systemVersionCmdF
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the server version.

methods.name: systemStatusCmdF
methods.description: Fetches and displays the server's health status.

methods.name: systemSupportPacketCmdF
methods.description: Generates and downloads a support packet from the server.
